authenticity_review: The image demonstrates high photorealism in lighting and texture rendering, particularly the stone grain on the violins and fur detail on the raccoons. However, structural integrity issues exist: (1) There are three violins instead of two, with the leftmost one awkwardly fused/occluded behind the middle violin, creating a confusing silhouette. (2) The animal_pose_auditor flagged HIGH artifact risk (47% low-confidence keypoints) for raccoons, specifically in hind limbs and paws—visual inspection confirms some toe blending and anatomical ambiguity in the feet. (3) The SAM mask only captured one violin shaft, suggesting boundary detection struggles with the clustered objects. Despite these issues, the overall scene coherence and material rendering are strong.
